description: JSJ topology of ⁴He compositional braid closures via SnapPy. Compares canonical pppnnn vs three disjoint compositions (D⊕D, T⊕p, ³He⊕n) at the link-exterior hyperbolic-volume level.  Tests F1 question 2: whether compositional choices produce the same topological invariant after JSJ reduction.
caveats: Averaged Hecke crossings (c=1, d=-h/2) DON'T have a single topological realization.  This probe converts averaged → σ (positive crossing) per F1 convention; averaged → σ⁻¹ would give a different topology.

F1's disjoint Markov composition β_1 ⊕ β_2 is the DISJOINT braid product (strands of β_2 above β_1).  Its closure is a 2-component link, while canonical pppnnn is a single-component knot in general.  Topological invariants (volume) differ accordingly — expected behaviour.
